mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% for a month, strong labor market confidence drives equity inflows, causing positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.5% or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust demand, boosting corporate profits and investor sentiment, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up 2% and RSAFS up 1% over 1 month
failure_condition: Proxies do not move as expected or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising for 2 months), investors anticipate higher rates, leading to short-term negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS not in tightening or 20-day returns not negative.

mechanism_narrative: High INDPRO (supply index) over 3 months indicates strong production capacity, reducing upward price pressure and lowering risk premiums, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: When household demand (HOUST) exceeds 1066 units for a month, it signals robust consumer spending, driving corporate earnings and positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: HOUST does not exceed threshold or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 5% and GDPC1 rises by 3% in a month, strong labor market and economic growth create a positive feedback loop, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up 3% and UNRATE <5% for 1 month
regime_hint: labor market strengthening coupled with growth
failure_condition: Proxies do not align or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO drops 10% for 2 months), investors anticipate production bottlenecks, leading to short-term negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not drop as expected or 60-day returns are not negative.
